description: Read authoritative report decisions and party main-vote groups separated by avser, or a member’s session main votes. Report mode requires report or documentId; ballots true with an explicit point adds individual member ballots and independent ballotPage continuation. Member mode requires memberId. Follow complete local continuation calls. Main votes do not include every ballot round; empty rows never prove acclamation.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: Mode fields conflict, a required mode identifier is missing, or a filter is invalid. `revision_changed`: The complete record changed during continuation. `unknown_point`: The existing report lacks the requested point. `ambiguous_report`: More than one exact report matched. `upstream_identity_mismatch`: Source identities contradict the required selection. `upstream_schema_invalid`: Present payload violates the wire contract. `upstream_unavailable`: Network or source failure remains after retries. `upstream_queue_full`: Process upstream queue is full. `candidate_limit_reached`: The complete main-ballot candidate boundary is reached. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
